text:
𝟭𝟵𝟴𝟯! 𝗞𝗔𝗣𝗜𝗟'𝗦 𝗗𝗘𝗩𝗜𝗟𝗦 🏆

India beat the mighty West Indies by 43 runs at Lord's on 25 June 1983.
India made just 183, then bowled WI out for 140. A nation fell in love with cricket. 🇮🇳

#Cricket #1983WorldCup

facebook.caption:
𝟭𝟵𝟴𝟯: 𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗮 𝗻𝗲 𝗱𝘂𝗻𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝗷𝗲𝗲𝘁 𝗹𝗶! 🏆🇮🇳

👉 Lord's, 25 June 1983 – India ne West Indies ko 43 run se haraya
👉 India 183 par out, phir West Indies ko 140 par roka
👉 Kapil Dev ki captaincy mein pehla World Cup

Is jeet ki kaunsi yaad sabse khaas hai? Comment karo 👇
